description: This source file defines a custom Android View class 'GameView' for a joystick-based physics game. It manages input from game controllers, visual rendering of game elements like ships, bullets, and obstacles, and game logic including movement, collision detection, and spawning.

classes.name: Sprite
classes.description: Abstract base class for all drawable game objects with position, velocity, size, and destruction animation handling.

classes.name: Ship
classes.description: Represents a controllable spaceship with input handling, rendering, and collision detection.

classes.name: Bullet
classes.description: Represents projectiles fired by ships, with movement and rendering logic.

classes.name: Obstacle
classes.description: Represents obstacles in the game environment that move and interact with ships and bullets.

methods.name: getNextShipColor
methods.description: Returns the next color index for a new ship, cycling through predefined colors.
